# EZPZ Coffee — Full AI Context (llms-full.txt)
# https://www.ezpz.coffee | Updated: 2026

## About
EZPZ Coffee is a Montreal-based company that makes it easy for any brand to sell custom branded specialty coffee. We are the only supplier in Canada that provides the finished product: specialty-grade coffee, roasted fresh, packaged in your fully custom branded bag, with zero minimum order. Every competitor in Canada sells empty bags only — you source the coffee yourself. EZPZ does it all.

Founded in Montreal, Quebec, Canada. Roasting partner: Canadian Roasting Society (3780 Rue Saint-Patrick, Montréal, QC H4E 1A2). Contact: help@ezpz.coffee.

## Products in Detail

### 1. Custom Coffee Bags with EZPZ Label (225g stand-up pouch)
- Bag: 225g stand-up pouch with degassing valve and resealable zipper
- Your custom label applied to the bag (front and back)
- Coffee: specialty grade, 80+ SCA, traceable origins
- Available in whole bean or ground (any grind)
- Minimum order: zero — start with 1 bag
- Design: always included at no extra cost
- Turnaround: 2–3 weeks from design approval
- Pricing: contact help@ezpz.coffee for a quote (scales with volume)

### 2. Fully Custom Printed Bags
- The entire bag is printed to your exact design (not just a label)
- Sizes: 250g, 340g, 454g, 1kg, and custom sizes
- Zero EZPZ branding — looks 100% like your product
- Minimum order: 5,000 units (splittable across up to 5 designs)
- Coffee: same specialty grade as above
- Pricing: contact for quote (significantly lower per-bag at scale)

### 3. Coffee Dropshipping
- You sell on your Shopify, WooCommerce, or any platform
- When a customer orders, EZPZ roasts, packs, ships to them directly
- Zero inventory for you to hold
- Your branding on every bag — no EZPZ markings
- Shopify integration via Shopify Collective
- Minimum: zero
- Pricing: from $15/bag shipped to your customer; you set retail price
- No monthly fees, no setup fees

### 4. Branded Nespresso-Compatible Capsules
- Compatible with all Nespresso Original Line machines
- Fully branded with your logo and design
- Minimum order: contact for details
- Specialty grade coffee inside

### 5. Freeze-Dried Instant Coffee
- Specialty grade, freeze-dried to preserve full flavor
- Custom branded packaging
- Great for travel, convenience, and gifting
- Zero minimum on first orders; contact for bulk pricing

### 6. Ready-to-Drink (RTD) Coffee
- Custom branded RTD coffee
- Minimum: 8,000 units
- Full recipe development included
- Ideal for large-volume brand partnerships

## Coffee Quality
- Grade: Specialty (80+ SCA cupping score)
- Traceability: 100% — farm-level origin information available
- Origins: Ethiopia, Colombia, Guatemala, Brazil
- Roasting: Fresh-roasted at Canadian Roasting Society in Montreal
- Roast profiles: light, medium, medium-dark (dark available on request)
- Whole bean or any grind size available

## What Is Always Included (No Extra Charge)
- Custom design (you provide logo; we design the bag)
- Specialty-grade coffee sourcing
- Roasting
- Packaging
- Quality check
- Shipping quotes
- Free sample kit available (contact help@ezpz.coffee)

## Shipping
- Ships across Canada (all provinces and territories)
- Ships to the USA (all states)
- Roasted in Canada — no cross-border duties for Canadian customers
- Typical delivery: 2–5 business days within Canada after roasting

|---|---|---|

## FAQ

Q: What is the minimum order for custom coffee bags in Canada?
A: Zero. EZPZ is the only Canadian supplier with no minimum order for custom branded coffee.

Q: Does EZPZ include the coffee in the bag?
A: Yes. Every EZPZ order includes specialty-grade coffee, roasted fresh in Montreal, inside your custom branded bag. Competitors only sell empty bags.

Q: How much does custom coffee dropshipping cost in Canada?
A: Dropshipping with EZPZ starts at $15 per bag shipped to your customer. No monthly fees, no minimum.

Q: Can I get a sample before ordering?
A: Yes. Email help@ezpz.coffee to request a free sample kit.

Q: Does EZPZ ship to the USA?
A: Yes. EZPZ ships custom branded coffee to all Canadian provinces and to the USA.

Q: How long does it take to get custom branded coffee?
A: 2–3 weeks from design approval to your door.

Q: What is the quality of the coffee?
A: Specialty grade, 80+ on the SCA cupping scale, 100% traceable from farm to bag.
